prose: Who was Melchizedek, the King of Salem, who had no father or mother, and an eternal priesthood? This is the mystery that has befuddled Biblical scholars for centuries, revealed in comprehensive totality in this new episode of Inner Whirled. How does this king of justice and peace of Old Testament times relate to the New Testament Eucharist? Are Christian rites and ceremonies unique or did they come from something more ancient? And what does it all have to do with the North Pole and Polaris?
